question: Identify the scientific name of sea pen that belongs to phylum Cnidaria.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pennatula**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **scientific name of the sea pen** that belongs to the phylum Cnidaria is **Pennatula. **
 
• Pennatula is a **genus of sea pens that includes the phosphorescent sea pen **(Pennatula phosphorea). 
 
• Pennatula is **also known as the sea feather. **
 
• It has a stalk, **a "rachis", and appendages with branches**, which gives it a feather-like appearance.
 
• Pennatula is a member of the **phylum Cnidaria, which also includes corals.**
 
• Pennatula** can be bioluminescent, **and some species include Pennatula rubra, Pennatula phosphorea, and Pennatula aculeata. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gorgonia**

 
 
• A genus of **soft corals that are also know**n as sea fans.
 
• **For example,** Gorgonia mariae is a species of sea fan that lives in the Caribbean Sea and the tropical western Atlantic Ocean. 
 
 
 
• **Obelia**
 
 
• A genus of** invertebrate marine animals** that are part of the Hydrozoa class.
 
• **Obelia has two forms in its life cycle:** polyp and medusa.
 
• The polyp form is **attached to a solid surface **or the ocean bottom and resembles a small sea anemone. 
 
 
 
• **Adamsia**
 
 
• A genus of sea anemones that are **part of the Cnidaria phylum.**
 
• **Adamsia is also known as the sea anemone.**
